_comment: opening: hook (default: strongest close, sharp shot first) | establish (wide setting first); override per run with --opening. Pacing POLICY (named, editable, ablation-tested in docs/CREATIVE_EVAL.md). Shot lengths in seconds; targets are the reel length window.
